mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the GDP growth rate signals a strengthening demand cycle that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the federal funds rate within the past month signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the unemployment rate and a decrease in payroll employment within the past month signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
